expo.name: Guide Pup: Vision Assistant
expo.description: Assistive navigation guidance for blind and low-vision users using camera-based scene analysis and safe spoken cues.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Guide Pup uses your camera to analyze what is ahead for assistive navigation. Camera frames are sent to Guide Pup's backend and may be processed by third-party AI providers.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Guide Pup uses the microphone for optional hands-free voice commands such as start, stop, repeat, and spoken settings changes.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Guide Pup uses speech recognition for optional hands-free voice commands. Spoken commands are parsed on-device into a bounded control set.
